anya: Quick summary of today's cross-GPU/region bench: Llama-2-13B, Mistral-7B, Qwen-14B on A100-40, H100, and T4 across us-west-2 / eu-west-1 / ap-southeast-1. Ran seq len 512/2048/4096, batch=1/4/8, int8/4bit/FP16.

sam: dump the p95s?

anya: pasted the highlights below (very condensed). full logs attached in the gist link.

anya: A100-40 (us-west-2):
```
model    seq512 p95   seq2048 p95  seq4096 p95  tps(seq512)
llama13B  18ms        45ms          145ms        98 tok/s
mistral7B 20ms        52ms          160ms        92 tok/s
qwen14B   25ms        80ms          260ms        60 tok/s
```

liz: Qwen looks rough at long contexts. did you enable rope/gqa patches?

anya: For Qwen we tried two variants: native rope and rope-fix (offset correction). rope-fix reduced p95 at 4k by ~25% on A100. But Qwen still regresses on H100 for seq>2048.

raj: H100 notes?

anya: H100 (eu-west-1):
```
model    seq2048 p95 fp16-kernel  fp16-fallback
mistral7B 48ms     fused-attn (fast)  fallback=generic (120ms) <-- kernel compatibility issue
qwen14B   90ms     no fused kernel, fallback
llama13B  42ms     optimized kernels present
```

sam: so mistral had a fused-attn that was faster but fell back in our runtime on some H100 driver combos?

anya: Exactly. On H100 with driver 535.x we see the custom fused kernel load fail for certain matrix shapes (seq>=2048 + batch>1). Runtime falls back to generic attention which spikes latency x2. We need a ticket to support that kernel shape or add shape-aliasing.

liz: T4 results?

anya: T4 (ap-southeast-1) small: FP16 works but memory limited. We had to quantize to 4-bit for Qwen to fit, but 4-bit inference increased perplexity on the eval set by ~3% for Qwen (Llama unaffected). Mistral quantized well to 4-bit with <1% perf loss.

raj: Any KV-cache anomalies across archs?

anya: Yes: Qwen's position-embedding scheme interacts poorly with our prefix-KV eviction for very long context; we observed token-level latency spikes when the cache wrap happened at ~3.5k tokens. Llama and Mistral unaffected. Likely a rope/GQA edge case.

sam: Can you paste the mini command we used to run the bench?

anya: Yes, on the runtime harness:
```
./run_bench --model=model_name --gpu=A100-40 --region=us-west-2 --seq=4096 --batch=1 --quant=4bit --profile=latency --out=out.json
```

anya: out.json snippets: 
```
qwen14b seq4096 p95=260ms p50=190ms tokens/sec=60 kernel=fallback generic
mistral7b seq4096 p95=160ms p50=130ms tokens/sec=92 kernel=fused-attn (if loaded)
llama13b seq4096 p95=145ms p50=110ms tokens/sec=98 kernel=optimized
```

liz: Sounds like action items: 1) kernel compat ticket for H100 fused-attn 2) reproduce Qwen rope wrap spikes with isolated KV test 3) run quantized quality eval for Qwen with more prompts 4) update capacity sizing doc. Agree?

anya: Yep. I'll open the tickets and attach logs + perf flamegraphs.

raj: For capacity sizing: based on these numbers, a single A100-40 can do ~900 concurrent seq512 llama13B steady tokens/sec with batching and our batching latency SLO 200ms. For Qwen at long context you need ~1.6x GPU capacity or move to H100 with kernel fixes.

sam: @infra-bot can we schedule a driver rollback test matrix in eu-west-1 to reproduce the H100 failure?

infra-bot: scheduled: driver-535/driver-540 matrix in eu-west-1, start time 2024-06-21T02:00Z, job id infra-1247.

anya: Follow-ups:
- ticket #ML-678: H100 fused-attn shape load fail (assign: eng-runtime)
- ticket #ML-679: Qwen KV wrap spike reproducer (assign: eng-ml)
- task: run full eval-suite (512 prompts) for Qwen 4-bit vs fp16, due EOD Friday
- update capacity-sizing spreadsheet with per-arch multipliers (draft branch open)

liz: Can someone add the perf charts to the PR? quick pngs show the drop at seq>2k for Qwen.

anya: Posted charts here: https://gist.github.com/redwood-perf/bench-1719043200 (contains CSVs + flamegraphs).

sam: Thanks. If we fix the kernel, we expect Mistral to beat Llama on tokens/sec for batch>=4 on H100 due to better attention packing. Keep me posted on infra test results.

anya: will do.

raj: One more note: quantization backend mismatch caused slowdowns in our quant path for Qwen on T4 (extra dequant/requant ops). We should add a microbenchmark for quant op throughput.

anya: Added microbench to the bench harness, will run across regions after infra tests.

liz: Nice. no blockers from product. Thanks team :thumbsup:

anya: Thanks — I'll update this thread with ticket links and a short readme for reproducing.
